item.subject: science
item.stem:
Krish studies three pure samples in the lab: sulphur powder made of only sulphur particles; sugar crystals made of particles that each contain carbon, hydrogen and oxygen joined together; and nitrogen gas made of identical molecules that each contain only nitrogen.

Which claim correctly classifies a substance as an element?

options.A: Sulphur powder and nitrogen gas are elements because each is a pure substance made of only one kind of identical particle.
options.B: Sugar crystals are an element because the sample looks uniform and pure.
options.C: Sulphur powder is an element even if its particles were of two different kinds mixed together.
options.D: Nitrogen gas is a compound because each nitrogen molecule contains more than one nitrogen particle joined together.
